name: Compliance Obligation
description: Reusable definition of a statutory compliance requirement. Shared across all tenants — customer-specific behaviour lives in Compliance Calendar Task.

fields.label: Obligation Title
fields.description: Action-oriented, max 80 chars. E.g. 'File GSTR-3B Monthly Return'

fields.label: Obligation Code
fields.description: Short immutable code used in integrations, e.g. GSTR-3B-MONTHLY

fields.label: Section / Rule Reference
fields.description: E.g. Section 39, Rule 61, Form 5A

fields.label: Category
fields.options:
Labour
Tax & GST
Secretarial / MCA
Environment
Fire & Safety
Industry-Specific
Data Privacy
ESG
Finance / RBI
Other

fields.label: Frequency
fields.options:
Daily
Weekly
Fortnightly
Monthly
Bi-Monthly
Quarterly
Half-Yearly
Annual
Bi-Annual
On-Event
Continuous
One-Time

fields.label: Due Timing Rule
fields.description: Plain-English rule for computing due date. E.g. '20th of the following month', 'Within 30 days of FY end'. Parsed by the Applicability Engine.

fields.label: Applicability Rules
fields.description: Rules evaluated by the Applicability Engine to decide if this obligation applies to a Business Entity.

fields.label: Applicability Rules
fields.description: AND/OR chain of rules. All must pass (net result) for the obligation to apply.

fields.label: Min. Employees Threshold
fields.description: Obligation applies only if entity has >= this many employees. 0 = no minimum.

fields.label: Max. Employees Threshold
fields.description: Obligation applies only if entity has <= this many employees. 0 = no maximum.

fields.label: Applicable States
fields.description: Leave blank = all states. Populate to restrict to specific states.

fields.label: Applicable Industries
fields.description: Leave blank = all industries.

fields.label: MSME Applicable
fields.description: Checked = this obligation applies to MSMEs too (most do). Uncheck for large-entity-only obligations.

fields.label: Max Penalty (₹)
fields.description: Maximum statutory penalty in Indian Rupees. Used in Penalty Exposure Report.

fields.label: Penalty Description
fields.description: Human-readable summary of penalty structure.

fields.label: Compliance Complexity
fields.description: Effort required to complete — used for workload planning.

fields.label: Imprisonment Risk
fields.description: If checked, personal liability attaches. Task escalated to Director by default.

fields.label: Non-Compliance Can Block Business
fields.description: E.g. licence cancellation, factory closure order.

fields.label: Required Evidence Types
fields.description: Defines what evidence must be uploaded before a task can be marked Complete.

fields.label: Form / Filing Name
fields.description: E.g. Form 5A, GSTR-3B, DIR-3 KYC

fields.label: Submission Portal URL
fields.description: Deep link to the government portal for filing.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.description: Comma-separated terms for full-text search. E.g. 'gst, return, monthly, 3b'

fields.label: Implementation Guidance
fields.description: Step-by-step notes for the Compliance Officer. Shown in Task Detail view.

fields.label: Extraction Source
fields.options:
AI-Extracted
Manual
Partner Content
Legacy Migration

fields.label: Validated by Lawyer
fields.description: Legal Counsel user who reviewed and approved the obligation content.

fields.label: Published
fields.description: Only PUBLISHED obligations are picked up by the Applicability Engine to generate tasks.

fields.label: Supersedes
fields.description: When an obligation replaces an older one, link the superseded obligation here.
